verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(p)=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")}catch{return ""}};const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const f=r("lib/marketing/funnel-config.ts");for(const a of ["second_act","studio_keeper","network_steward"])if(!f.includes(a))fail("no funnel door is keyed to the "+a+" archetype");if(!/Who Frequency is for/.test(r("app/llms.txt/route.ts")))fail("llms.txt has no Who Frequency is for section");const w=r("lib/page-editor/templates/what-is-frequency.ts");for(const x of [/just moved/i,/run club/i,/timer/i,/teacher/i,/studio/i])if(!x.test(w))fail("the Who is Frequency for answer leaves out a family: "+x)'
verify.note: Fails while a Builder archetype has no door, llms.txt lacks the section, or the Who is Frequency for answer leaves out a family. The /for/teachers door and its Portfolio Teacher archetype were retired by ADR-1863.

append.detail: 2026-10-22 LIVE-1130 (ADR-1863): the launch narrowed to four doors, so /for/teachers and /for/community-builders were retired with redirects. The probe no longer requires the teachers door or the portfolio_teacher archetype; every other check is unchanged.
